nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

productUrl.description: Etsy products HTTPS direct link. Userinfo must not be included; Host must be `etsy.com` or its subdomain, port must be omitted or `443`; path must be `/listing/<numeric ID>`, with at most one non-empty title slug, and can have trailing slashes and query parameters
